comment: Aggregate compact 8-type MBTI feature dataset made by merging mb3iMaster, mbtiB_all_noIE, and mbtiA_flaired_noIE. I/E remains removed. Each group is merged count-weighted; raw counts are reconstructed as probability × total before summing.

metadata.note: Top-level itemCounts/bodyChars are available for mbtiB_all_noIE and mbtiA_flaired_noIE. mb3iMaster did not include itemCounts/bodyChars, so it contributes to group feature totals but not to these top-level item/body tallies.

keyboardInitial.comment: Count-weighted aggregate group 'keyboardInitial'. Tokens are stored once; probabilities are reconstructed from source probabilityMatrix × source totals, summed, then renormalized.
